title: Without Being Attuned To The Saadh Sangat,
summary: Sangat is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:; without being attuned to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
lifeApplication: Move closer to one company that helps the heart tell the truth. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
